description: This PHP class defines a strategy for purging records by replacing specific field values with formatted values. It handles retrieval of records related to an employee number, applies formatting strategies to designated fields, and persists the updated entities.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for replacing entity attribute values with formatted values during data purging.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Retrieves entities based on employee number and applies record purging to each.

methods.name: purgeRecord
methods.description: Replaces specified fields in the entity with formatted values and persists the changes.

methods.name: getReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a formatting strategy object based on the strategy name.
